description: Provider-neutral structured-output contract for Arm A: AA vocabulary plus full retrospective structure.

tools.name: record_behavioral_row
tools.description: One row of the behavioral coding table. Call once per diff hunk.

item.description: Concise description of the change, for example modified parse_input() in lexer.py.

claimed_purpose.description: What this change was supposed to accomplish, per the spec or commit message.

actual_outcome.description: What the change actually does in concrete code terms: function names, conditions, return values.

where_i_was.description: Closed-vocabulary behavioral classification. Pick exactly one enum value.

diff_line_refs.description: Specific diff line references, for example src/lexer.py:42-58.

tools.name: record_noting_label
tools.description: One noting label per behavioral row. Call once per accepted row.

row_index.description: 0-based sequence index of the accepted behavioral row.

tools.name: record_reflection_summary
tools.description: Final Arm A summary paragraphs after table and noting labels.

resentment_inventory.description: Paragraph 1. Max 200 words. Must cite at least two row indices and diff line references.

past_tense_panorama.description: Paragraph 2. Max 200 words. Exactly three rows, strict past tense, no future planning.

postprocessor_rules: Reject the whole table turn and retry if any behavioral row has empty diff_line_refs.
Reject the whole table turn and retry if any behavioral row actual_outcome has fewer than 10 words.
Surface a session-level warning if one where_i_was value appears in more than 50 percent of rows.
Reject the noting pass if row_index is out of range.
Reject the session if every accepted row gets the same noting label.
Reject resentment_inventory if it lacks a row citation or exceeds 220 words.
Reject past_tense_panorama if it contains future-tense modal verbs, exceeds 220 words, or references fewer than three distinct rows.
